result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but one prominent loading indicator appears to be left over the main restaurant card and obscures its imagery.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is visibly overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, making the card appear unfinished and obscuring the food image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner after the image/content finishes loading, or show it only while the card is actively loading and ensure it cannot remain stuck indefinitely.
